dvids.title: UCT One Seabee Divers Complete Six-Month Expeditionary Engineering Deployment in U.S. 6th Fleet
dvids.desc: U.S. Navy Seabee divers assigned to Underwater Construction Team (UCT) One, Construction Dive Detachment 1-3[AM1.1] (CDD 1-3), completed a six-month deployment in the U.S. 6th Fleet area of operations.

dvids.title: USS Milius Conducts Machine Gun Calibration Exercise
dvids.desc: A Mark 38 machine gun system fires rounds into the ocean during a pre-action calibration exercise aboard the Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Milius (DDG 69), Sept. 22, 2026. Milius is deployed to the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations in support of maritime security and stability eff

dvids.title: The Last to Stand the Watch: The Sunset of the USS Georgia (SSGN 729)
dvids.desc:
USS Georgia’s final chapter is being written by the sailors who called her home.
"For the last time ever, surface, surface, surface," said Senior Chief Machinist’s Mate Auxiliary John Edwards, his voice carrying through the ship's general announcing system.
